annotations.title: Draft a message to a found person

description: LinkJolt's own first message to one revealed person, the same draft the Find affiliates page writes: from the page they were found on and the campaign's real terms, with a follow-up for 4 days later. Returns the subject, body and follow-up, the campaigns it can invite them to (defaultCampaignId is the one the brand chose), their address and whether it is verified, and footerPreview, the lines LinkJolt adds under every message (where they were found, the business's name and postal address, an unsubscribe link, the privacy note). needsPostalAddress true means nothing can be sent until the person adds the business postal address under Business in Settings. The draft is saved on the person, so the page shows it too; again: true writes a fresh one. Nothing is sent. Requires Pro plan or higher.

again.description: Write a fresh draft instead of returning the saved one (default false)
